pricing_requirements:
- 12-month minimum preferred but open to 6-month on trial.
- Commit bands: 200k tokens/day base, burst up to 300k tokens/day pooled.
- Overage: capped at 20% month-on-month after notification, prefer fixed pct over per-token spike.
- Ramp schedule: month1 40%, month2 70%, month3 100% of committed throughput.
- Want transparent cost breakdown (tokens vs instance-hours) and monthly cost forecast report.
